name: Longkou Union Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Longkou Union Chemical Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of azo organic pigments and water-based inks within the Chinese market. Its chemical products are widely utilized in the production of inks, coatings, and plastics. The company, established in 2007 and headquartered in Longkou, China, operates as a subsidiary of Longkou Sunshine Chemical Co., Ltd.
